name: big_jump
poster_pose_summary: The duck is at the highest point of a joyful jump, both feet off the ground, both wings raised high, mouth open in a big smile, body slightly stretched upward.
notes: Keep the full body centered. This is the static sticker poster pose for jumping.

name: flapping_celebration
poster_pose_summary: The duck stands on the ground and spreads both wings wide upward in a big celebratory flap, smiling brightly.
notes: Make the pose read as celebrating or flapping even when static.

name: fast_happy_steps
poster_pose_summary: The duck leans slightly forward in a playful quick-step pose, one foot lifted, the other planted, tiny bounce in the posture, happy face.
notes: Readable as lively fast little steps.

name: full_spin
poster_pose_summary: The duck finishes an energetic spin facing three-quarter front, one foot slightly lifted, wings opened a little for balance, delighted expression.
notes: Use a dynamic twisted body feeling but keep silhouette clean.

name: tail_wiggle
poster_pose_summary: Back view of the duck with hips tilted to one side and tail slightly emphasized, as if mid tail wiggle.
notes: Back-facing and cute; static image should imply tail shaking.

name: victory_pose
poster_pose_summary: The duck stands front-facing with both wings thrust high overhead in a triumphant victory pose, broad smile.
notes: Very readable celebratory silhouette.

name: cheerful_step_dance
poster_pose_summary: Side view, one foot high in an exaggerated dancing step, body bouncing, one wing slightly out, smile on face.
notes: Should read like a cheerful step dance.

name: run_toward_camera
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing pose with one foot forward, one foot back, wings slightly out, body leaning forward as if running toward the viewer, excited smile.
notes: Even as a still image it should read as approaching quickly.

name: lying_kick_flap
poster_pose_summary: The duck lies on its back at a three-quarter angle, feet up in the air, wings slightly spread, laughing happily.
notes: Poster pose should clearly show a playful upside-down reaction.

name: proud_pose
poster_pose_summary: The duck stands proudly in three-quarter view with chest puffed out, beak slightly raised, one foot confidently forward.
notes: Readable as proud / self-assured.

name: full_body_laugh
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck leaning back with mouth open in big laughter, wings slightly lifted, body shaking with joy.
notes: Big laugh, no tears yet.

name: rolling_laugh
poster_pose_summary: Side view of the duck tilted strongly sideways as if laughing so hard it is about to roll, feet loose, wings lifted a bit.
notes: Pose should suggest loss of balance from laughter.

name: tears_of_laughter
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck laughing loudly with tears at the eyes, wings slightly out, body lifted with laughter.
notes: Tears are okay but eye design should remain simple.

name: giggle_cover_mouth
poster_pose_title: giggle with one wing covering beak
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter front pose with one wing lightly covering the beak while the duck giggles, eyes happily curved.
notes: Cute restrained laugh.

name: big_clap
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck with both wings brought together clearly in front of the chest in a clap pose, bright smile.
notes: Static image should unmistakably read as clapping.

name: self_hug
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck wrapping both wings around its own body in a self-hug, content expression.
notes: Should read as hugging itself.

name: pull_to_chest
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter front pose, wings extended forward as if receiving something and pulling it back toward the chest, gentle happy face.
notes: Should read as drawing something cherished close.

name: come_for_hug
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck opening both wings very wide toward the viewer, stepping forward slightly with a big welcoming smile.
notes: Static pose should feel like “come here for a hug”.

name: squish_cheeks
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck pressing both cheeks with its wings, cute smile.
notes: Should read as cheek squish instantly.

name: spin_and_pose
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter front finishing pose after a spin, body slightly twisted, one foot pointed, one wing out, self-satisfied smile.
notes: Poster pose should feel like ta-da after spinning.

name: frozen_shock
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck stiff with surprise, wings slightly away from body, eyes wide, beak small and tense.
notes: Should read as frozen in shock.

name: step_back_in_shock
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter front pose with one foot stepping backward, body leaning away, eyes widened, wings slightly raised.
notes: Static image should show recoil.

name: astonished_wings_open
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck with both wings suddenly spread wide and beak open in surprise.
notes: Classic big surprise silhouette.

name: look_left_right
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck with the head turned sharply to one side, body still front-facing, slightly tense posture.
notes: Readable as looking left/right quickly.

name: anxious_turning
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter view duck twisted as if indecisively turning, feet not aligned, wings slightly up, worried face.
notes: Should show hesitating and changing direction.

name: panic_hold_head
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck holding the sides of its head with both wings, eyes wide, distressed expression.
notes: Static pose should clearly say panic.

name: dizzy_stagger
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter front duck leaning heavily off-center with wobbling stance, eyes confused, wings slightly spread for balance.
notes: Should read as dizzy staggering.

name: fall_on_bottom
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck already falling backward onto its bottom, both feet lifted forward slightly, surprised face.
notes: Pose should show the instant of plopping down.

name: run_away
poster_pose_summary: Side view duck sprinting away fast while glancing backward over its shoulder, fearful expression.
notes: Clear fleeing silhouette.

name: hard_brake
poster_pose_summary: Side view duck leaning sharply backward with feet braced forward as if braking hard, wings slightly out for balance.
notes: Readable as sudden stop.

name: cry_loudly
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck crying loudly, mouth wide open, large tears streaming, wings raised a little in distress.
notes: Strong readable cry pose.

name: sit_and_sob
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter front duck sitting on the ground, body hunched, tears falling, wings close to body.
notes: Should read as seated sobbing.

name: collapse_flat
poster_pose_summary: Side view duck slumping downward onto the ground, body flattened with no energy, eyes dull or closed.
notes: Readable as total collapse.

name: sad_walk
poster_pose_summary: Side view duck taking a slow step with head hanging low and droopy posture.
notes: Static image should feel like trudging sadly.

name: turn_away_and_sulk
poster_pose_summary: Back view duck turned away from the viewer with slightly hunched shoulders and head lowered, body leaning to one side in a sulky mood.
notes: This is the desired dedicated poster pose for sulking from behind.

name: wipe_tears
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck wiping one eye strongly with one wing, tears still present, face scrunched.
notes: Should read as actively wiping tears.

name: slow_collapse
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck with knees bent and body sinking, head low, wings drooping completely.
notes: Poster pose should show losing strength.

name: big_yawn_and_stretch
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter front duck yawning hugely with beak open and both wings stretched upward.
notes: Very readable yawn/stretch.

name: dozing_off_standing
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck standing but nodding off, eyes closed, head tilted forward, body still upright but droopy.
notes: Should read as almost asleep while standing.

name: lie_down_sleep
poster_pose_summary: Side view duck curled down low on the ground ready to sleep, eyes closed, peaceful expression.
notes: Poster pose should show lying down to sleep.

name: stomp_one_foot
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck lifting one foot high for a strong angry stomp, angry eyebrows, wings tense.
notes: Big readable anger.

name: spread_wings_threat
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck spreading both wings wide in an intimidating threat display, angry face.
notes: Static pose should feel confrontational.

name: trembling_anger
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck trembling with contained rage, fists/wing tips clenched inward, angry expression.
notes: Body should look tense and vibrating.

name: thrust_beak_forward
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter front duck lunging the beak forward aggressively, chest and head jutting out.
notes: Should read as arguing or confronting.

name: angry_protest
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck thrusting one wing outward in complaint, mouth open as if protesting.
notes: Readable as objecting strongly.

name: turn_head_hmph
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing torso with head sharply turned away to the side, eyes narrowed, beak pouty.
notes: Classic hmph / offended look.

name: turn_back_completely
poster_pose_summary: Back view duck fully turned away from the viewer, one foot planted firmly as if after an angry turn.
notes: Readable as turning its back on someone.

name: shake_head_no
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck with head swung to one side and beak closed in refusal, body tense.
notes: Static pose should read as “no”.

name: march_away_angry
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter rear or back view duck marching away angrily with one foot high and body tense.
notes: Strong readable angry departure.

name: hands_on_hips_pose
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck with both wings planted at its sides like hands on hips, beak slightly raised.
notes: Clear defiant posture.

name: deep_bow
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck already in a polite bow with eyes closed, both wings resting naturally at the sides.
notes: Important: face front; readable as bowing, not sleeping.

name: strong_nod
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck with head dipped strongly downward in the deepest point of a forceful nod, determined face.
notes: Should read as strong nodding.

name: tilt_head_curious
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck with head and upper body dramatically tilted to one side, curious expression.
notes: Simple cute curiosity pose.

name: sneak_walk
poster_pose_summary: Side view duck tiptoeing with one foot raised high and body lowered slightly, alert sneaky face.
notes: Should read as sneaking.

name: peek_over_shoulder
poster_pose_summary: Back view duck looking back over one shoulder toward the viewer.
notes: Back-facing but readable character face.

name: point_with_wing
poster_pose_summary: Three-quarter front duck pointing clearly to one side with one wing while looking that way.
notes: Should read as indicating something.

name: slip_and_fall
poster_pose_summary: Side view duck in the instant of slipping: one foot shooting forward, body leaning back, both wings spread wide, alarmed expression.
notes: Strong readable slipping moment; not just walking.

name: chase_tail
poster_pose_summary: The duck twists around trying to look at its own tail, body curved in a playful chasing motion.
notes: Static pose should imply circling after its tail.

name: shake_dry
poster_pose_summary: Front-facing duck in a vigorous body shake, feathers puffed a bit, wings lifted slightly, face squeezed shut or focused.
notes: Static image should imply vigorous shaking dry.

name: sprint_across_frame
poster_pose_summary: Side view duck in a strong full sprint pose with body leaning clearly forward, front leg reaching far ahead, back leg stretched far behind, both wings streaming backward.
notes: Important: this must read as FAST RUNNING even as a still image.
